title: Search Suggestions System
description: You are given an array of strings `products` and a string `searchWord`. For each prefix typed from `searchWord`, suggest at most three product names with common prefix sorted lexicographically.
input_format: First line contains `n` and `searchWord`. Following `n` lines contain the products.
output_format: For each typed prefix, space-separated suggestions (at most 3) on a new line.

sample_tests.input:
5 mouse
mobile
mouse
moneypot
monitor
mousepad
sample_tests.output:
mobile moneypot monitor
mobile moneypot monitor
mouse mousepad
mouse mousepad
mouse mousepad
sample_tests.explanation: Prefix suggestions after typing m, mo, mou, mous, mouse.

sample_tests.output:
havana haven havoc
havana haven havoc
havana haven havoc
havana
havana
havana

hints: For each character appended to prefix, filter products starting with that prefix.
Using binary search (bisect) locates matching prefix bounds in O(log N).

starter_code.python:
# Search Suggestions System
import sys

def solve():
    data = sys.stdin.read().split()
    if not data: return
    # Write your solution here
    pass

if __name__ == '__main__':
    solve()

reference_solution:
import sys
lines = sys.stdin.read().splitlines()
if lines:
    parts = lines[0].split()
    n, word = int(parts[0]), parts[1]
    products = sorted(lines[1:1+n])
    prefix = ''
    for c in word:
        prefix += c
        matches = [p for p in products if p.startswith(prefix)][:3]
        print(' '.join(matches))
